prompt:
电商新品上市图。核心任务：明确传达“这是一个值得关注的新商品 / 新版本”。受众：{由用户输入，或根据新品定位与资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据新品资料总结}。文案：{只使用用户提供的核对过的文案}。新品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。新品亮点：{由用户提供，或从新品资料中提炼真实变化与核心价值}。发布时间、上市信息：{仅在用户资料明确提供时使用}。其余发布感、视觉冲击与画面表现请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。

本次输入：【填写商品外观、图的用途、已核对的规格与可展示文案】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
E-commerce new arrival launch image. Core task: Clearly communicate that "this is a noteworthy new product / new release". Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on new release positioning and data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on new release data}. Copy: {Use only approved copy supplied by the user}. New product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Product highlights: {Provided by user, or extracted as authentic changes and core values from new release data}. Launch date / release info: {Use only when explicitly provided in user data}. Autonomously design the launch energy, visual impact, and graphic presentation. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

Inputs: [Provide product appearance, purpose of the image, verified specifications, and approved copy].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.
